The company added Nicolás Salinas, a specialist in fish immunology and physiology, who will participate in the development of new biotechnological methodologies and applications, including an immunological stimulant aimed at enhancing the production of antibodies and contributing to reducing mortality associated with microbial agents Biochemist from the Pontifical Catholic University of Valparaíso and doctor in Biotechnology from the Federico Santa María Technical University and the PUCV, Ni

title.es: Salmonicultura mueve $3,2 billones con proveedores y aporta más de $74 mil millones al Estado
title.en: Salmon farming moves $3.2 billion with suppliers and contributes more than $74 billion to the State
title.no: Lakseoppdrett flytter 3,2 milliarder dollar med leverandører og bidrar med mer enn 74 milliarder dollar til staten

summary.es: Más de $74.000 millones en impuestos y pagos al Estado registraron durante 2025 las seis empresas socias del Consejo del Salmón. El monto considera impuestos directos, concesiones acuícolas y permisos no territoriales. A esto se suman $3,2 billones en pagos a proveedores nacionales realizados durante el mismo período. Las cifras corresponden a AquaChile, Australis Seafoods, Cermaq, Mowi, Salmones Aysén y Ventisqueros. Los resultados forman parte del sexto Reporte de Impacto Sostenible (RIS) del Consejo del Salmón . El documento fue elaborado bajo la metodología Sustenta+ y reúne más de 140 indicadores. Estos datos permiten medir el desempeño económico, social y ambiental de la salmonicultura
summary.en: More than $74,000 million in taxes and payments to the State were registered during 2025 by the six member companies of the Salmon Council. The amount considers direct taxes, aquaculture concessions and non-territorial permits. Added to this are $3.2 billion in payments to national suppliers made during the same period. The figures correspond to AquaChile, Australis Seafoods, Cermaq, Mowi, Salmones Aysén and Ventisqueros. The results form part of the Salmon Council's sixth Sustainable Impact Report (RIS). The document was prepared under the Sustenta+ methodology and brings together more than 140 indicators. These data allow us to measure the economic, social and environmental performance of salmon farming.
summary.no: Mer enn 74 000 millioner dollar i skatter og betalinger til staten ble registrert i løpet av 2025 av de seks medlemsbedriftene i Salmon Council. Beløpet tar hensyn til direkte skatter, akvakulturkonsesjoner og ikke-territoriale tillatelser. I tillegg kommer 3,2 milliarder dollar i betalinger til nasjonale leverandører i samme periode. Tallene tilsvarer AquaChile, Australis Seafoods, Cermaq, Mowi, Salmones Aysén og Ventisqueros. Resultatene inngår i Lakserådets sjette Sustainable Impact Report (RIS). Dokumentet ble utarbeidet under Sustenta+-metodikken og samler mer enn 140 indikatorer. Disse dataene lar oss måle den økonomiske, sosiale og miljømessige ytelsen til lakseoppdrett.

El Encuentro Institucional “AquaPacífico 10 años: Resultados, innovación y futuro” se realizó en el Hotel Serena Suite de La Serena. La actividad reunió a representantes del sector público, la academia, empresas y comunidades vinculadas a la acuicultura. summary.en: Ten years after its creation, AquaPacífico celebrated its first decade with a meeting focused on innovation, technology transfer and sustainability. The Institutional Meeting “AquaPacífico 10 years: Results, innovation and future” was held at the Serena Suite Hotel in La Serena. The activity brought together representatives from the public sector, academia, companies and communities linked to aquaculture. title.es: Subrei pone al salmón entre las prioridades de negociación con EE.UU.: “Volver a un arancel cero para el 100% es complejo”
title.en: Subrei puts salmon among the priorities of negotiation with the US: “Returning to a zero tariff for 100% is complex”
title.no: Subrei setter laks blant prioriteringene i forhandlinger med USA: «Å gå tilbake til en nulltariff på 100 % er komplekst»

summary.es: El salmón se encuentra entre las principales prioridades de Chile en las negociaciones comerciales que mantiene con Estados Unidos para mejorar las condiciones de acceso de los productos nacionales tras la aplicación de nuevos aranceles. Sin embargo, desde el Gobierno reconocen que regresar a un escenario de arancel cero para la totalidad de las exportaciones chilenas aparece, por ahora, como un objetivo complejo. Así lo señaló la subsecretaria de Relaciones Económicas Internacionales (Subrei), Paula Estévez, en una entrevista publicada por El Llanquihue , donde abordó el impacto de la política arancelaria estadounidense sobre la salmonicultura y las gestiones que desarrolla Chile para conse
summary.en: Salmon is among Chile's main priorities in the trade negotiations it maintains with the United States to improve access conditions for national products after the application of new tariffs. However, the Government recognizes that returning to a zero tariff scenario for all Chilean exports appears, for now, as a complex objective. This was stated by the Undersecretary of International Economic Relations (Subrei), Paula Estévez, in an interview published by El Llanquihue, where she addressed the impact of the US tariff policy on salmon farming and the efforts that Chile is developing to achieve
summary.no: Laks er blant Chiles hovedprioriteringer i handelsforhandlingene det holder med USA for å forbedre tilgangsforholdene for nasjonale produkter etter innføring av nye tollsatser. Regjeringen erkjenner imidlertid at det å gå tilbake til et nulltollscenario for all chilensk eksport foreløpig fremstår som et komplekst mål. Dette ble uttalt av undersekretær for internasjonale økonomiske relasjoner (Subrei), Paula Estévez, i et intervju publisert av El Llanquihue, der hun tok for seg virkningen av USAs tollpolitikk på lakseoppdrett og innsatsen som Chile utvikler for å oppnå.
